title: Setting up Recurring Payments
text:
## Setting up Recurring Payments
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000046485
This article explains how to configure recurring membership payments, including monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and yearly billing cycles, as well as recurring subscriptions with optional one-time setup fees.
Sometimes, admins want to add a one-time payment + a recurring subscription or they might only want a regular subscription.
If this is the case, follow these simple steps to set it up correctly:
1. Go to Finance » Membership Plans and click Edit:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12172838167/original/8Nz0FBu__jRS1jXRlzaJ2pm-aPY9Lw0hdQ.png?1767713254 | alt: ]
2. Then go to the "Sign Ups & Upgrades" tab. Scroll down and add the price of the recurring options:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12117393234/original/9suNNENZ_dWesE4GLyaRmiQ14-wsfVHcsA.png?1668690553 | alt: ]
Do the same if need to set up a "One-time setup fee" option + recurring payments.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12117393260/original/YM4bncLLXRrMjeaWAQsFNwhT1BDXpQv4JQ.png?1668690593 | alt: ]
3. Make sure the "Account type" says "Paid".
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12117393291/original/3YJOTQjjK0P7MRT0oQ_RU6V2iWAj2YVS9w.png?1668690607 | alt: ]
When the price has been set up, scroll up and click the "Sign Up Page" button:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12092390908/original/Eq2yBSb8wyy-6Vwx4SUVAsTRVci1UNUIww.png?1620597965 | alt: ]
Make sure the price is showing up correctly in the "Checkout" Form:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12092390922/original/0tco7OHRFm5rH0bkEipO6SE1bg-gmXzMcw.png?1620598106 | alt: ]
To create one-time payments, read this article: Setting up One Time Payments .
If Free Membership Plans need to be created, read this documentation: Setting up Free Membership Plans .
If need to edit the amounts displayed on the /join page, read these articles:
Side-By-Side Pricing Plans: How To Link Membership Plans To The Price Matrix
Guide 5. How to Edit Public Pricing Page (the /join page)
